rationale: I picked the 10 indirect calls whose function names (hot_lockredirect, hot_syscallredirect) suggest they reach a lock or syscall through a pointer, which a category-only screen would miss. I also picked direct calls that stop a hot function outright and are easy to fix: the sleep family, waitpid and accept. I left out the generic and clean_fp indirect calls, the allocations, trylock and the other locks, and the I/O calls that may be non-blocking.
